t: The Forge Steel post level is an essential compact tool for precise vertical and horizontal alignment in various construction and landscaping applications. Features 3 high-visibility vials, which include a 90° vial and 2 x 180° vials, to ensure accurate measurement with a 1.75 mm/m tolerance. The durable post level is ideal for tradespeople working on fencing installations, decking joist alignment, or setting gate posts. Designed with a robust ABS plastic body to withstand demanding job site conditions. Includes 4 powerful inlaid magnets to securely attach the level to ferrous metal surfaces, allowing for hands-free operation and improved efficiency during critical levelling tasks.
